purpose: Show a result or viewpoint opposite to the expected direction.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
I rushed to fix it and ended up breaking it instead.
I meant to warn her, but it actually encouraged her.
Cities are convenient, but conversely it is hard to find somewhere quiet.
restrictions: Requires a meaningful reversal or contrast.
mistake: It does not simply mean “on the other hand” for unrelated facts.
